name: Dendro Core
description:
When a Bloom reaction is triggered: Deal Piercing DMG equal to one-third of your stacks to a random opponent.
After you deal Pyro DMG: Deal Pyro DMG equal to your stacks to all opponents, then destroy this card.
After you deal Electro DMG: Deal Piercing DMG equal to your stacks to the 2 opposing characters with the lowest HP, then destroy this card.
(Can stack, no stack limit)
